summary: Exploratory result S3 was promoted into the research problem and expanded into five sequential questions.
cause: The prior workflow started from already-computed results instead of a verified academic problem and substantive anchor.
prevention: Treat large/significant exploratory results as Fact Bank entries; define Research Object and verified substantive anchor before freezing the Core RQ.
trigger: User or agent proposes studying a variable mainly because it is largest, fastest-growing, or most significant.
evidence: Advisor discussion + v4 strict reset of the regional innovation policy project.
